series: Meme Street: one real stock chart a day

0400.name: the new chart
0400.job: Today's mystery chart is live: show the months before the game, never what comes next, and ask the vote that tonight's reel answers.

0900.name: a new way in
0900.job: A way of showing the game nobody has seen: its own art style, never the style of the last seven of these.

1600.name: a new way in
1600.job: The same as 09:00, in a different style and with a different idea.

2330.name: the answer
2330.job: The story behind today's mystery chart: always the same form (the chart, the reveal, why it moved, the vote, the midnight line).

link_line: One real chart a day, two minutes to trade it: memestreet.net
disclaimer: Practice money only. Not investment advice.

motion.exit: power3.in, 40 to 50 percent shorter than the entrance
motion.sfx: one frame after its picture, 3 to 6 dB over the music
